text: {"lessons":["Staged sales of Stock E realized substantial gains, but I should base future trades on prospects and portfolio balance, not the satisfaction of locking in profits.","Buying Stock A, D, and E after a decline is not automatically a bargain; past price moves and my purchase price do not predict future returns.","Since prices move randomly and I review infrequently, avoid reacting to small account fluctuations and make measured, diversified decisions."]}
